title: Demon and Candy Girls
description: A towering blue demonic figure with large curved horns stands in a glowing stone archway, dripping green liquid from its hands. Two young girls with braided hair kneel in a psychedelic candy landscape holding mushrooms while a third girl in a pink tutu and roller skates dances joyfully to the right, surrounded by giant mushrooms, candy canes, and floating hot air balloons against a swirling purple sky.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a tall muscular blue demon with large curved horns emerging from a crumbling stone archway dripping green slime. In the foreground two young girls with flower crowns and braided hair kneel in shallow psychedelic water holding colorful mushrooms, while a third blonde girl in a frilly pink tutu and roller skates dances with arms outstretched. The landscape is filled with giant glowing mushrooms, candy canes, swirling rainbow rivers, and whimsical hot air balloon houses floating in a dramatic purple cloudy sky.
